static float g_angle = 0.0f;
static int   g_rotating = 0;

void display() {
  glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | GL_DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
  glLoadIdentity();
  glPushAttrib(GL_ALL_ATTRIB_BITS);
--- render_state ---
  glEnable(GL_MULTISAMPLE);
  glDisable(GL_LINE_SMOOTH);
  glColorMaterial(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_AMBIENT_AND_DIFFUSE);
--- camera ---
  glTranslatef(0.0000f, 0.0000f, -7.5000f);
  glRotatef(0.0000f, 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
  glRotatef(0.0000f, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
  glTranslatef(0.0000f, -0.2500f, 0.0000f);
--- header_post ---
--- source ---
  float dist, n, x, y, ang;
  glClearColor(0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 1);
  dist = 1.4;
  n = 400;
  glBegin(GL_LINE_LOOP);
    for(i, 0, n) {
      ang = TAU * i/n;
      x = dist * cos(t*ang) + cos(ang);
      y = dist * sin(t*ang) + sin(ang);
      glVertex3f(x, y, 0);
    }
  glEnd();
